how: real DSH + framework plugins, scripted model, mock LINE (examples/purchase-requests/demo/run.mjs)

checks.step: 1 a request waited 3 days → purchase.unanswered + approval.requested → only the named approver gets the notice and the card [Approve] [Reject]
2 the approver taps Approve → recorded in the business system (approved, by the approver, channel im) → card updated → the requester is told
3a the requester asks → purchase_list_requests with the requester's own delegation → the answer has the request and its status
3b another staff member asks about the same request → purchase_get_request is "not found" for them (404) → the AI says it cannot see it
